purpose.en: Explore a comfortable inner-thigh stretch in a wide-knee position.

text.zh: 膝盖向两侧打开，脚尖朝外，臀部慢慢往后坐
text.en: Knees wide, toes out, sit your hips back slowly

text.zh: 缓慢移动，停在自己能控制的幅度
text.en: Move slowly and stop within a range you can control.

text.zh: 保持呼吸，回程也要平稳

commonErrors.zh: 强压髋部追求过大的幅度
commonErrors.en: Forcing the hips into an excessive range.

commonErrors.zh: 出现不适仍弹震或继续加深
commonErrors.en: Bouncing or pushing deeper despite discomfort.

cautions.zh: 膝：使用舒适垫面，膝部承托不适时不要继续加宽。
cautions.en: Knees: use comfortable padding and do not widen the stance through knee discomfort.

cautions.zh: 大腿内侧与髋：缓慢后坐，只保留可控拉伸感，不弹震、不让他人强压。
cautions.en: Inner thighs and hips: rock back slowly within a controlled stretch without bouncing or being pushed.

cautions.zh: 腰背：保持躯干可控，不为更深后坐强行塌腰或憋气。
cautions.en: Lower back: keep the trunk controlled instead of forcing a deeper rock through the lower back or breath-holding.
